# Fieldset

Fieldset — a legend plus the fields it groups. A thin, token-styled wrap around Base UI's Fieldset: `Root` renders the `<fieldset>`, `Legend` renders a `<div>` already wired to `aria-labelledby` the fieldset. `RadioGroup` builds on this; a "Checkbox group" is the same composition with `Checkbox` instead.

Also asked as: field group.

**Import:** `import { Fieldset } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Fieldset.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Fieldset.stories.jsx` — Default, CheckboxGroup, WithRequiredAndError, Required, Invalid, Disabled, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/Fieldset.mdx`

## Usage

Use a fieldset wherever a set of fields shares one label and, often, one validation message: a group of radios, a group of checkboxes, related text fields asked together. For a single field with its own label, use the label and caption convention instead.

## Best practices

### One `error` covers the whole group. {#one-error-covers-the-whole-group}

Pass `error` on the Fieldset, not on each field inside it, when the validation applies to the set as a whole: "Choose at least one", for example, rather than a field-by-field message.

```jsx
<Fieldset legend="Notify me by" isRequired error={error}>
    <Checkbox label="Email" />
    <Checkbox label="Text" />
</Fieldset>
```

### Build on a fieldset rather than reimplementing it. {#build-on-a-fieldset-rather-than-reimplementing-it}

Radio group already composes Fieldset with Radio children. Reach for Radio group directly for radios, and use Fieldset on its own only for a shape it does not already cover, like a checkbox group.

Do: A fieldset with one legend for the set.
Don't: Loose boxes in a plain container, with no legend.

### Group related fields under one legend. {#group-related-fields-under-one-legend}

The legend names what the fields have in common. Without it a screen reader hears loose, unrelated fields.

Do: The legend names the group.
Don't: A legend that says nothing.

### Keep the legend to a few words. {#keep-the-legend-to-a-few-words}

A legend is a label, not an instruction. Two or three words stay on one line.

Do: One short line.
Don't: A whole sentence as the legend.

### Name the group, not the action. {#name-the-group-not-the-action}

The legend says what the fields are. The button says what to do with them.

Do: A noun phrase.
Don't: An instruction.

## Accessibility

- **A real `fieldset` and `legend` pair.** The legend is tied to the group through native HTML semantics, which every screen reader already understands.
- **The error is announced once.** `role="alert"` on the error message means assistive technology hears it as soon as it appears, without needing focus to move there.
- **`isRequired` is visual and spoken.** The asterisk is `aria-hidden`, and a visually hidden "(required)" is added to the legend's accessible name.

## Parts

1. **Legend.** Names the group, in body default. A required marker follows it.
2. **Fields.** The grouped fields, stacked with `--stack-md` between them.
3. **Error.** One message under the fields, in body small.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Required | An asterisk in `--ds-text-danger` follows the legend. A visually hidden "(required)" joins its name. |
| Invalid | The error shows in `--ds-text-danger`, announced with `role="alert"` and linked with `aria-describedby`. |
| Disabled | The native `disabled` attribute disables every field inside. |

A fieldset has no hover, pressed or focus state of its own. The fields inside carry theirs.

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Legend | `--ds-text`, body default. |
| Required marker, error | `--ds-text-danger`; the error in body small. |
| Gap | `--stack-md`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Write the legend as the question or topic: "Notify me by". | A generic legend: "Options". |
| Use sentence case and no end punctuation. | Title case, or a colon after the legend. |
| Say what to do in the error: "Choose at least one." | "Required" or "Invalid". |
| Keep the legend short enough to read as a heading. | A paragraph of instructions in the legend. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `id` | string | — | Id of the fieldset. The legend and error ids derive from it. A generated id is used when omitted. |
| `legend` | node | — | Labels the fieldset's contents. |
| `isDisabled` | bool | `false` | Disables the fieldset and every control inside it. |
| `isRequired` | bool | `false` | Marked on the legend. |
| `error` | node | — | One error for the group, announced when it appears. |
| `children` | node | — | The fields the legend groups. |
| `className` | string | `''` | Extra class on the `<fieldset>`, beside `plus-fieldset`. |
| `style` | object | — | Inline style on the `<fieldset>`. |
